stemMd: What looked like an effortless performance was the product of months of rehearsal; its apparent spontaneity was carefully ______.
explanationMd: The sentence contrasts appearance with preparation. Contrived means deliberately arranged, fitting the idea that an unplanned-looking effect can be produced through extensive rehearsal.

distractorRationale.d: The performance resulted from preparation, not forgetting.
distractorRationale.e: The preparation created, rather than blocked, the appearance.
distractorRationale.c: Months of rehearsal indicate deliberate attention.
